articles.title: YOUR AI FEATURE IS GETTING USED. BUT IS IT PAYING OFF?
articles.summary:
Most AI features don't fail because of pricing. They fail because the AI is not valuable enough to justify what it costs to deliver. Usage grows, costs scale, and margins start disappearing.

See the patterns behind AI features that actually pay off [5]: the pros and cons of popular pricing models, the traps that thin your margins, and practical tips from Kyle Poyar, founder of Growth Unhinged, and Aakash Gupta, founder of Product Growth, based on their work with teams shipping AI at Atlassian, Bolt, Salesforce, Cursor, and dozens of other companies.
